title: Chocopoes SMP 2
description: This modpack is made for the Chocopoes SMP 2. This is a lightweight modpack that keeps the essence of vanilla minecraft but adds a lot of needed features.
body:
# Chocopoes
This modpack is specifically made for the Chocopoes SMP 2. This modpack aims to keep minecrafts essence while adding needed feautures. 

![Chocopoes logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e963ddd0d679ec4d71cbedf85a46e14b0f788f89.png)

## **How to install**
1. Download the modrinth app
2. Search for Chocopoes SMP 2 and click install
3. Run the instance and play! 

### **Tips:**
**Check your keybinds!** _Some things could be different then what u are used to. Change them to how u like it._

**Set up your voice chat.** _Press **B** to open the voice chat menu. From here u can configure the right in and outputs. Also u can changes other peoples volumes if they are too loud or too quiet._

For better performance u can change the graphic settings. Head to ur settings> video settings and from there change all the options from fancy to fast. Also u can disable or enable shaders.

For more questions u can join the [Discord server](https://discord.gg/BTFQe5CmDc)

Credits to [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/) for their resource pack.
